name: Falcon USD
oneLiner: USDf is Falcon Finance's overcollateralized synthetic dollar minted 1:1 from stablecoins or via dynamic ratios against BTC, ETH, SOL, and altcoin collateral.
collateral: Overcollateralized: stablecoins (USDC, USDT, USD1, FDUSD) minted 1:1; volatile assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, select altcoins) with dynamic overcollateralization ratios based on volatility and liquidity
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized synthetic dollar; liquidation mechanisms and arbitrage maintain the $1 peg; delta-neutral strategies power sUSDf yield

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDf resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: USDf uses AccessControl mint/admin roles; the verified Ethereum default-admin path is a 4/6 Safe, while active minter-role holders still need enumeration.

controls.label: USDf default admin Safe
controls.evidence: Verified source uses AccessControl; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by this Safe. getThreshold() returned 4 and getOwners() returned 6 owners at Ethereum block 25165911. Active MINTER_ROLE holders remain unresolved.

review.evidence: Falcon documentation presents USDf as issuer/protocol-operated; verified Ethereum source and role reads identify a 4/6 Safe admin path but not the full active minter set.
